title: Issue derived vira plannable com spec vazio: o planner inventa todos os oraculos
description:
`cam issue --file-local --derived-from <id>` promove a issue direto para stage:specified com specSource:derived, mas grava um objeto `spec` VAZIO. A issue passa por isPlannable e chega ao planner sem nenhum acceptanceCriteria e, portanto, sem nenhuma FORMA de oraculo.

Medido em main, 2026-07-28, sobre os 4 issues plannable:
- CAM-331 (specSource ausente, passou por entrevista /cam-spec real): 6 acceptanceCriteria
- CAM-432 (derived): 0 acceptanceCriteria
- CAM-441 (derived): 0 acceptanceCriteria
- CAM-447 (derived): 0 acceptanceCriteria

Ou seja 3 de 4 candidatos plannable entregam ao planner apenas prosa (descricoes de 3952 a 6703 chars) e zero criterio estruturado. O planner e obrigado a inventar cada oraculo a partir de texto livre.

Isso e exatamente a causa-raiz ja documentada em scripts/cam/patterns.md:1078 (bloco curado de oracle authoring, CAM-439): "deliver the FORM of the oracle, not the claim. Stating what must be true and leaving the planner to invent the check is what produced the escalations above; the planner then invents something unsatisfiable or vacuous." O bloco foi promovido depois de SETE ciclos consecutivos cujo defeito nasceu no spec e nao no planner (CAM-398, CAM-425, CAM-420, CAM-424 duas vezes, CAM-433, CAM-434). O CAM-447 e o oitavo: escalou em 2026-07-28 com o auditor apontando textualmente que nenhum criterio carregava sweep red-on-main e que um oraculo ja era verde em main.

O canal estruturado que o bloco curado exige (spec.acceptanceCriteria carregando o texto literal do oraculo, ja varrido) existe no schema e esta literalmente sem uso em todo issue derived.

Consertar, opcoes a decidir com o operador:
(a) isPlannable passa a exigir spec.acceptanceCriteria nao vazio, de forma que uma issue derived precise de um passo de spec antes de planejar;
(b) --derived-from passa a gravar stage:idea em vez de specified, forcando /cam-spec;
(c) o caminho derived passa a exigir que as formas de oraculo sejam fornecidas no momento da filagem.

Nao confundir com CAM-448 (lint e auditor dividem o mesmo budget de re-plan): aquele e o motivo de o auditor nao conseguir CORRIGIR o defeito; este e o motivo de o defeito EXISTIR. Sao complementares.

Relacionado: CAM-439 (oraculo de fidelidade de evidencia), CAM-448.

Quality gates green: `bun run typecheck`, `bun test`, `bun run check:all`.
spec.scope: Close the gate that lets an issue reach the planner with zero oracle forms. Two coordinated changes: (1) isPlannable (src/issues/plannable.ts:19) additionally requires non-empty spec.acceptanceCriteria, and buildNotPlannableReason (src/commands/plan.ts:164-169) reports that rejection reason; (2) the --file-local filing path (index.ts:2534-2542 -> src/commands/issue-file.ts:271/307-308 -> src/issues/alloc.ts:135-149) gains a channel to supply and persist acceptance criteria at filing time, so a derived/fast-tracked issue can be filed already carrying swept oracle forms. DECOMPOSE BY VERIFICATION MODE, not story count: the predicate half is verified by pure in-process unit tests (no I/O), the filing half by real-git integration against a tmpdir repo. OUT OF SCOPE: persisting prior audit findings across a fresh plan run, and the shared re-plan round budget (CAM-448). Do not touch src/supervisor/plan-runner.ts.
gotchas: INTENDED BLAST RADIUS: the moment this lands, CAM-432, CAM-441 and CAM-447 stop being plannable until each gets a spec pass. Confirmed with the operator 2026-07-28. Do not add a grandfather clause or a legacy exemption.

--fast-track (specSource:'operator') takes the SAME alloc.ts:135-136 branch as --derived-from and also produces a spec-less specified issue. Apply the gate uniformly to both; a specSource-conditional gate would leave the same hole open under a different flag.

`cam suggestions promote` files through this same path (see test/supervisor/suggestion-filing-production.test.ts and test/commands/suggestions.test.ts). Verify a promoted suggestion does not become permanently unplannable.

buildIssueEntry OMITS the spec key entirely (alloc.ts:137-149) -- it is not {} and not null. The guard must handle spec === undefined, and noUncheckedIndexedAccess applies to any array access on acceptanceCriteria.

The runtime schema mirror at src/vendor/_generated.ts:40 (key 'scripts/cam/issues.schema.json') places NO constraint on spec and requires only specSource for stage:'specified'. If the schema is tightened, `bun run embed-vendor` and `bun run embed-vendor:check` must both run.

IssueEntry.spec is optional (src/issues/types.ts:49) but Spec.acceptanceCriteria is REQUIRED inside Spec (src/issues/spec.ts:9), so the only reachable empty state is a missing spec object or an empty array.
